description: Implementation of the ShippingService interface handling loading, saving, and processing shipping configurations, quotes, and modules for an e-commerce platform.

classes.name: ShippingServiceImpl
classes.description: Service class implementing shipping-related operations, including configuration management, quote calculation, and module handling for an e-commerce system.

methods.name: getShippingConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves stored shipping configuration for a merchant store.

methods.name: getShippingConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves specific shipping module configuration based on module code.

methods.name: getCustomShippingConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves custom configuration for a specific shipping module.

methods.name: saveShippingConfiguration
methods.description: Saves or updates the shipping configuration for a store.

methods.name: saveCustomShippingConfiguration
methods.description: Stores custom configuration for a shipping module.

methods.name: getShippingMethods
methods.description: Returns available shipping modules applicable to the store.

methods.name: saveShippingQuoteModuleConfiguration
methods.description: Validates and saves configuration for a shipping quote module.

methods.name: removeShippingQuoteModuleConfiguration
methods.description: Removes a shipping quote module configuration.

methods.name: removeCustomShippingQuoteModuleConfiguration
methods.description: Removes a custom shipping module configuration.

methods.name: getShippingModulesConfigured
methods.description: Fetches all enabled shipping modules configured for the store.

methods.name: getShippingSummary
methods.description: Creates a summary object for shipping costs and options.

methods.name: getShippingQuote
methods.description: Calculates and retrieves a shipping quote based on delivery, products, and store settings.

methods.name: getSupportedCountries
methods.description: Returns a list of supported destination countries for shipping.

methods.name: getShipToCountryList
methods.description: Returns list of countries to which shipping is available.

methods.name: setSupportedCountries
methods.description: Updates the list of countries supported for shipping.

methods.name: requiresShipping
methods.description: Checks if the shopping cart requires shipping based on its items.
